mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 declines over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signal a shift in consumer spending from goods to real estate, leading to sector-specific gains and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, leading to increased costs for businesses and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.
